card.name: Digits inside numbers in data
card.fires_on: A single digit that sits in the middle or start of a multi-digit or decimal number in clinical data, such as lab tables, confidence ranges and percentages. It is not the first digit in a plain number or a word.

modes.label: Digits in table values
modes.description: A digit inside a decimal or bracketed value in a results table or interaction table.

modes.label: Digits in ranges and percents
modes.description: A digit within a percentage, range, or confidence interval in running text.
modes.example: The mean increase in olanzapine AUC is 52% and 1<<0>>8%, respectively.
